sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: [THRESHOLD] gs:TRF049_FrameShape SPARQL constraint with message "Each installed bracket must be at least as thick as the frame web, with a stiffened edge against buckling.": The constraint cannot detect a bracket thinner than the frame web: its outer FILTER NOT EXISTS requires that no valid frame thickness exists, while its inner FILTER EXISTS simultaneously requires a valid frame thickness. Consequently, a bracket with bracketValue < frameValue is accepted whenever the frame thickness is valid. Required change: Replace the contradictory filters with logic that rejects an installed bracket when no valid frame thickness exists or when any bracket thickness is less than the frame web thickness, while preserving the existing stiffening requirements and inclusive greater-than-or-equal threshold. | [LOGIC] gs:TRF049_FrameShape SPARQL constraint with message "A frame running through a supporting structure must provide a valid integer web-plate connection side count of exactly 2 and must connect both sides of its web plate to the relevant supporting structure.": The connection test verifies only one generic frame-attachment link reciprocated by the supporting structure. It does not identify or require two distinct web-plate sides, nor evidence that each side is connected by direct welding, a collar plate, or a lug. A single connection can therefore satisfy the constraint while the other web-plate side is unconnected. Required change: Represent and require two distinct side-specific connection records or equivalent evidence, with both sides linked to the relevant supporting structure and each connection identified as direct welding, collar plate, or lug. | [CARDINALITY] _:TRF049_WithinIceTrue / gs:TRF049_FrameShape side-count logic: webPlateConnectionSideCount has no SHACL datatype or cardinality constraint. The SPARQL condition accepts a frame if it has any one xsd:integer value equal to 2, even when additional side-count values are also present, so the modeled count is not constrained to exactly one value of exactly 2. Required change: Add a property constraint for nltl:webPlateConnectionSideCount requiring exactly one xsd:integer value with sh:hasValue 2, or enforce the equivalent exact-cardinality condition in SPARQL.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: [MISSING_VALUE_BEHAVIOR] MainShape SPARQL constraint 'Each installed bracket must be at least as thick as the frame web': The constraint does not report a violation when frameWebThickness is absent or lacks a valid decimal millimetre value; the FILTER EXISTS block simply evaluates false, so an installed bracket can pass without the required comparison input. Required change: Require a valid frameWebThickness quantity for each applicable frame and make missing or invalid thickness evidence produce a violation before evaluating the bracket-thickness boundary. | [UNIT_CONVERSION] MainShape SPARQL constraint 'Each installed bracket must be at least as thick as the frame web': The comparison only recognizes frame web thickness values whose numeric value is xsd:decimal and whose unit is exactly MilliM; equivalent quantities in another unit are ignored rather than converted or rejected as missing evidence, which can let a thinner bracket pass. Required change: Compare compatible thickness quantities using explicit unit conversion, or impose and validate the same canonical millimetre representation on frameWebThickness and fail nonconforming values.

[LOGIC] gs:TRF049_FrameShape SPARQL constraint checking nltl:passesThroughSupportingStructure: The through-supporting-structure condition is satisfied solely by asserting webPlateConnectionSideCount equal to 2. This does not establish that both sides are actually connected to the supporting structure by the required welding, collar-plate, lug, or equivalent attachment relationship, so an unconnected frame can pass. Required change: Require two-side connection evidence that is explicitly associated with the relevant supporting structure or its frame attachment, using the canonical supporting-structure attachment relationship in addition to any side-count evidence.

[MISSING_VALUE_BEHAVIOR] gs:TRF049_FrameShape / fourth sh:sparql constraint: The both-sides connection requirement is enforced only when webPlateConnectionSideCount is a valid xsd:integer equal to 2. Missing, non-integer, or non-2 values cause the SPARQL constraint to return no result, so a frame running through a supporting structure can pass without evidence that both web-plate sides are connected. Required change: Require webPlateConnectionSideCount as a valid integer on applicable frames and make the through-support constraint fail unless the count is exactly 2 and the required connection relationship evidence is present.
